name: FORGE-Turbulence2D
reference_origin: GPU float64 256x256 3/2-dealiased 4-stage Cox-Matthews ETD-RK4 reference; Fourier Galerkin restriction with zeroed Nyquist lines

kolmogorov_ns.forcing_description: unidirectional sinusoidal Kolmogorov shear: curl f = -A * k_f * cos(k_f * y)

mhd2d.forcing_description: 2D cellular vortex forcing: curl f = -A * k_f * cos(k_f * x) * cos(k_f * y) bending uniform guide field B0 * e_x

delivery_policy.required: 80 independent parents (40 kolmogorov_ns + 40 mhd2d), float64 HR evolution, bit-exact LR replay, enforced F restriction commutation <=1e-12, independent complex-DFT restriction check, hard zero-mean/zero-divergence/CFL/non-collapsing-magnetic-energy screens
